narrative.overview: The landing page is a premium midnight sheet. It keeps the engineering-datasheet grammar — one ruled column with continuous rails, numbered Fig. NN figures, hairline rules, spec tables, registration ticks — but the voice is a quiet luxury instrument: a deeper midnight ground, one aged-iris accent used like lamplight, a single loud CTA per view, and captures seated in deep studio shadows with a faint top-light. The chrome is near-monochrome; the real app captures are the only full-color objects, lighting the sheet the way monitors light a dark room.
keyCharacteristics: One ruled sheet: continuous side rails, hairline rules between sections, everything composed as rows.
Numbered figure system: mono Fig. NN labels with the number in iris — the only all-caps tier besides the wordmark.
Near-monochrome chrome; the product captures are the only color; one iris accent, one loud CTA per view.
Schibsted Grotesk for display and body at natural width; JetBrains Mono for the annotation layer; Figtree 800 caps for the wordmark only.
The Index Dots mark: twelve ink dots on a ring around a solid iris core — the official logo, everywhere.
Motion is one quiet rise-and-settle; content never gates on JavaScript.

rules.name: The Product-Is-The-Color Rule
rules.body: Page chrome stays within the neutral ramp plus one iris. The app captures are the only saturated, multi-hue objects. If a decorative element wants color, it is wrong.

rules.name: The One-Loud-Object Rule
rules.body: Each view gets exactly one accent-filled element (the hero CTA). Secondary CTAs are hairline ghosts. Two competing accent fills is the SaaS tell this redesign exists to avoid.

rules.name: The Lamplight Rule
rules.body: Glows are near-invisible: the hero may carry one iris-tinted top-light (≤7% alpha) and hero-scale captures an iris-tinted shadow (≤22% alpha). Everything else uses the neutral monitor-light. Anything louder is prohibited.

rules.name: The Fig Rule
rules.body: Every kicker is a figure label: mono, uppercase, ≤11px, Fig. NN in iris. The only other all-caps text is the wordmark.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No second display face and no width axis. Contrast comes from weight (400→640) and Ink vs Muted. Figtree appears only in the wordmark.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: If a boundary is needed, draw a hairline. A shadow that isn't seating a capture is dead weight.

dos: Do compose every section as a ruled row of the sheet; if a boundary is needed, draw a hairline, never a glow.
Do ship real captures of CadencR in every media slot, seated with contour shadow and neutral monitor-light.
Do keep chrome near-monochrome with the single iris accent and exactly one accent-filled CTA per view.
Do render the logo from tokens via LogoMark.astro; use the favicon cut for ≤32px rasters and Iris Deep on light grounds.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback and keep content visible without JavaScript.
Do spell the brand "CadencR" in prose and CADENCR in the wordmark; keep entity disambiguation intact.
Do carry this direction into the desktop app's future default theme: Midnight, Ink, Hairline, Iris.
donts: Don't build "a generic AI-startup landing page: no hype superlatives, no fabricated dashboards".
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe borders, aurora washes, decorative background grids, or glassmorphism.
Don't fill more than one element per view with iris. The nav Download stays a hairline ghost; the hero CTA is the loud one.
Don't reintroduce the per-section Dracula accent spectrum in page chrome. ANSI colors live inside terminal/app depictions only.
Don't let all-caps leave the fig-label + wordmark tiers, or mono leave the annotation layer.
Don't use a second display face, a width axis, or a light theme. Midnight (#0F0F13) is the only body color.
Don't animate layout or add entrance choreography beyond the single rise-and-settle.
